note: Reading tips for the resources added with the pathways, and day changes that move readings to the days that now teach their topics.

p-mdn-client-server.howToUse: Read it all; it is short. Picture each step as you go.

p-mdn-http.howToUse: Read up to and including HTTP messages. Skip the history and HTTP/2 sections.

p-nist-800-30.howToUse: Reference. Read the abstract and find the generic risk model figure; skip the rest.

p-owasp-bola.howToUse: Read the description and the example attack scenarios.

p-owasp-password-storage.howToUse: Read the introduction and the section on hashing versus encryption; skip algorithm settings.

p-nist-privacy.howToUse: Read the overview page to see how privacy risk differs from security risk.

p-owasp-llm02.howToUse: Read the description and example scenarios; skim the mitigations.

p-owasp-llm06.howToUse: Read the three forms of excessive agency and the mitigations closely.

p-owasp-llm08.howToUse: Focus on access control and poisoning; skim the embedding-inversion parts.

p-mcp-security.howToUse: Reference. Read the user consent and confused deputy sections; skim the rest.

p-mitre-atlas.howToUse: Browse the matrix and open two techniques; you do not need to read it all.
